newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says UPM has over 10 pct of votes.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says UPM has over 10 pct of votes.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Tuesday that forest industry group UPM-Kymmene's share of votes in it had risen to 10.43 percent due to conversion of K shares to A shares.

"The limit of 10 percent was exceeded due to the total voting rights in Nokia's share capital decreasing as a result of the K shares (entitled to 10 votes) having been converted to A shares (entitled to one vote)," Nokia said.
It said UPM-Kymmene had 11,619,984 K shares -- 3.88 percent of shares and 10.04 percent of votes -- and 29,720 A shares -- 0.01 percent of shares and 0.003 percent of votes.
